say:1:1033123001:1.text: Yes, some Wilders sent us some.
say:1:1033123001:1.source_cn: 不是我找到的，是那些绿裔成员送来的。
say:1:1033123001:1.male: Yes, some Wilders sent us some.
say:1:1033123001:1.female: Yes, some Wilders sent us some.

say:2:1033123002:1.text: They also taught me some simple ways to identify herbs, so I can recognize the common ones in the forest now.
say:2:1033123002:1.source_cn: 他们还教了我一些简单的草药辨别，森林里常见的那些我都认识了。
say:2:1033123002:1.male: They also taught me some simple ways to identify herbs, so I can recognize the common ones in the forest now.
say:2:1033123002:1.female: They also taught me some simple ways to identify herbs, so I can recognize the common ones in the forest now.

say:3:1033123003:1.text: I have to say, there really are so many plants here! You can find one with whatever effect you want.
say:3:1033123003:1.source_cn: 不得不说，这儿的植物还真是丰富呢，想要什么效果的草药都...
say:3:1033123003:1.male: I have to say, there really are so many plants here! You can find one with whatever effect you want.
say:3:1033123003:1.female: I have to say, there really are so many plants here! You can find one with whatever effect you want.

say:4:1033123004:1.text: ...Oh yeah, I still need to make some common medicines for everyone!
say:4:1033123004:1.source_cn: ……对了，还得做一些常用的药交给大家！
say:4:1033123004:1.male: ...Oh yeah, I still need to make some common medicines for everyone!
say:4:1033123004:1.female: ...Oh yeah, I still need to make some common medicines for everyone!
